item.title: Combiner 0.7.0
item.description:
• A daily anonymous usage summary to TelemetryDeck
  • Renders wait for swapping, not memory-pressure warning alone; Live renders watched too
  • Live WET with returns + main setting; group marks in the panel and web
  • ⚙︎ › DAW renders: hide freezes and bounces a background render covers
  • Memory-aware background renders (Auto cadence, heavy-project warning, wait for a break, pause while playing)
  • ORIGINAL prints, slices and COMP for Live renders
  • MIDI and synth patches from Live sets
  • Render All with a trailing-space project name, iCloud cloud-only projects stalling indexing, latent Live-beta renders
